decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 2)
The details submitted pursuant to condition 2 (materials) of planning permission 00271/25/P5 dated 17.09.2010 for refurbishment and change of use of the vacant pottery arms public house and the erection of a new building to provide two 3 bedroom houses (Within the public house) and two new 4 bedroom houses, including on-site parking and access arrangements, are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Reason (Condition 8)
The details submitted pursuant to condition 8 (landscaping) of planning permission 00271/25/P5 dated 17.09.2010 for refurbishment and change of use of the vacant pottery arms public house and the erection of a new building to provide two 3 bedroom houses (Within the public house) and two new 4 bedroom houses, including on-site parking and access arrangementsare considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Reason (Condition 9)
The details submitted pursuant to condition 9 (means of access) of planning permission 00271/25/P5 dated 17.09.2010 for refurbishment and change of use of the vacant pottery arms public house and the erection of a new building to provide two 3 bedroom houses (Within the public house) and two new 4 bedroom houses, including on-site parking and access arrangements, are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings)  of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
